steps.code: brew install rtk · winget install rtk-ai.rtk

steps.en: Run init for your agent, then restart the agent
steps.zh: 为你的智能体跑一次 init，然后重启它

steps.en: Installs a pre-tool hook that rewrites the agent's shell commands to rtk ones
steps.zh: 装上工具调用前钩子，把智能体的 shell 命令改写成 rtk 版本

component.zh: 智能体钩子（原生二进制）

steps.en: Let the agent work as usual — it runs git, tests, linters
steps.zh: 照常让智能体干活，它会跑 git、测试、lint

steps.en: Runs the real command, keeps the exit code, filters output by command type
steps.zh: 执行真实命令，保留退出码，按命令类型过滤输出

steps.en: Hands back failures only or a one-line confirmation; saves full output on failure
steps.zh: 只交回失败项或一行确认；失败时另存完整输出

value.en: The agent reads a few lines instead of pages of shell noise, with no per-command effort from you
value.zh: 智能体读几行而不是几屏 shell 噪音，你不用逐条命令操心

sources: https://github.com/rtk-ai/rtk README Installation (brew install rtk; winget install rtk-ai.rtk)
README Quick Start + Supported AI Tools (rtk init -g; rtk init -g --codex; restart; git status -> rtk git status; PreToolUse hook native binary)
README How It Works + Examples (filter/group/truncate/dedupe per command type; git push -> 'ok main'; cargo test failures only)
README Configuration ([full output: rtk recall 3f9c2a81d4e7] on failure; retriever mode sqlite)
docs/contributing/ARCHITECTURE.md Design Principles (exit code preservation; fail-safe fallback to original output)
